content.title: Lamar Odom Relives His Near-Death Overdose in New Docuseries
content.text: Lamar Odom and Khloe Kardashian Relive His Near-Death Overdose Lamar Odom is alive. He has not died. He did not die. So why did the title of a new docuseries episode about his life make me think that I forgot an important detail about Odom’s legacy? Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom follows the life of the very much still-alive former Lakers star and his near-death experience in 2019. The trailer begins with a 911 call where someone found Odom unconscious outside of a brothel in Nevada. “I had 12 strokes and six heart attacks. That’s not no average shit,” he explains. Featuring interviews from Odom; his ex-wife, Khloé Kardashian; and the former manager of the brothel he visited called the Love Ranch, the episode revisits the night that put Odom in the hospital. It includes a clip of the athlete saying, “That first hit of cocaine was amazing” while he imitates snorting a line, followed by Kardashian sharing how she felt a responsibility to cover up his drug use to “protect him.” Untold is a four-episode docuseries that follows four standalone stories about insane moments in sports, such as the 2024 chess match between Hans Niemann and Magnus Carlsen.
